title: Delete files ignoring missing ones
summary: Removes specified files but suppresses errors if a file does not exist. Useful for cleaning up files that may or may not be present.

steps.explain: Removes the specified files. If a file does not exist, the command continues without reporting an error.

placeholders.name: FILE_PATHS
placeholders.description: One or more paths to the files you want to delete.

warnings: Deleted files are not moved to the Trash/Recycle Bin and cannot be easily recovered.
The --force flag also suppresses prompts for write-protected files.

rollback.explain: There is no built-in command to undo file deletion. You must restore from a backup if available.
